envelope.description: Turn the MCP tools into forwarders

body.title: Turn the MCP tools into forwarders
body.summary: The seven tools forward over step.call with the MCP process's cwd, INSRC_REPO and the converted client; DaemonUnreachableError and DaemonTooOldError as isError envelopes; progress relayed only with a progress token. runInsrcMcpStdio stops registering the builtins, data drivers and workflow runners. Add the import-graph test of the MCP server.
acceptanceChecks: the MCP server's import graph, apart from ipc-client.ts and daemon-stream.ts, reaches nothing under src/db, src/analyze or src/daemon/steps, and a fixture import makes the test fail
with no daemon every moved tool returns DaemonUnreachableError; against a daemon without step.call, DaemonTooOldError
the twelve tools keep their names, descriptions and input schemas

tests.name: forwarder named errors: ENOENT/ECONNREFUSED give DaemonUnreachableError, unknown method or step-unknown-tool give DaemonTooOldError, and no handler runs
forwarder progress: frames relayed only with a progress token; the done envelope returned unchanged
import graph (ac4): the MCP server's modules reach nothing under src/db, src/analyze or src/daemon/steps; a fixture import makes it fail
MCP tool surface: the twelve tools keep their names, descriptions and input schemas
